description: Show or hide one of your Life and Work claims on your resume. Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

name: geode_lifeandwork_show_or_hide_claim
title: LifeAndWork: show or hide claim
